recentItems.title: The best of Sylvester Stallone on “Sunday Morning”
recentItems.description:
Watch interviews and never-before-aired footage from the actor’s appearances on “CBS Sunday Morning,” including:

A 2015 profile of Sylvester Stallone discussing his return to the character of Rocky Balboa as mentor for young Michael B. Jordan in “Creed”; 
A 2015 web extra in which he discusses writing the screenplay of “Rocky,” and the response to the film’s release; and 
A 2022 profile of Stallone on the set of his TV series “Tulsa King.”

recentItems.title: From the archives: The history of salt, in a pinch
recentItems.description:
Correspondent Martha Teichner talked with Mark Kurlansky, author of the bestseller "Salt: A World History,” to mine the story of how a simple compound chemically defined as NaCl became a substance that has shaped empires – and makes food taste better. She also talked with celebrity chef David Burke, and with Mark Bitterman and Jennifer Turner Bitterman, who sell 90 varieties of salt, and hold salt tastings, at their Portland, Ore., shop. (Originally aired Oct. 26, 2008.)

recentItems.title: Extended interview: Andy Beshear
recentItems.description:
In this web exclusive, Andy Beshear, the Democratic governor of Kentucky, talks with CBS News' Robert Costa about his new book, "Go and Do Likewise: How We Heal a Broken Country," and about his advice to Democrats on how to win over voters: "Just be real."
